run_interact_handler: run the interact_handler function to import the Interact dataset from a given artifacts path
split_paths_randomly: split a list of file paths into train, dev, dev-test, and test subsets using _split_paths
load_annotations_from_zip: load image annotations from a zip file using _load_annotations to get label-to-paths mappings
parse_annotation_line: parse a single annotation line into class label, class name, and image path using _parse_line
split_images_per_class: split images into train, dev, dev-test, and test subsets per class using _split_images_per_class
